-- Deterministic pseudo-random step: a linear congruential generator.
lcg_next(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0 and s < 2147483648
  post out >= 0 and out < 2147483648
  ex lcg_next(0) == 12345
  (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Returns a permutation of xs chosen by seed alone. No capabilities.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 3) == [1]
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  var s = seed % 2147483648
  let n = ys.len()
  for i in range(0, n)
    s = lcg_next(s)
    let j = i + s % (n - i)
    let t = ys[i]
    ys[i] = ys[j]
    ys[j] = t
  ys

test_shuffled_keeps_items() =
  let out = shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42)
  assert out.len() == 4
  assert out.len() == 4 and shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42) == out

test_shuffled_empty() =
  assert shuffled([], 9) == []
